SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Exclusive-As war began, Putin rejected a Ukraine peace deal recommended by his aide: sources","publisher":"Reuters","publication_date":"2022-09-14","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/exclusiveas-war-began-putin-rejected-a-ukraine-peace-deal-recommended-by-his-aide-sources-2891610","claim":"Reuters reported that Putin's chief envoy on Ukraine told him a provisional deal with Kyiv would satisfy Russia's demand that Ukraine stay out of NATO, but Putin rejected it, expanded objectives toward annexing Ukrainian territory, and pressed ahead with the military campaign.","locator":"lines 405-408","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"medium_high","source_confidence_reason":"Contemporaneous Reuters reporting based on sources close to the Russian leadership; the Kremlin denied it, so attribution is strong but not independently documented.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly in-period, February-September 2022.","ruler_attribution":"High: the decision is explicitly attributed to Putin by sources close to his leadership and concerns his choice over available peace terms.","contrary_evidence":["Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said the report had no relation to reality","A Ukrainian adviser said Russia was never interested in a peaceful settlement"],"lenses":["2B.1","2B.2","2B.3","2B.7","2B.10"]}

SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Russia: 'Filtration' of Ukrainian civilians a 'shocking violation' of people forced to flee war","publisher":"Amnesty International","publication_date":"2022-09-08","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2022/09/russia-filtration-of-ukrainian-civilians-a-shocking-violation-of-people-forced-to-flee-war/","claim":"Amnesty said Russian soldiers subjected Ukrainian civilians to abusive filtration, many displaced people reached Russia or Russian-occupied territory involuntarily, and vulnerable groups including children, older people, and people with disabilities were blocked or constrained from fleeing.","locator":"lines 63-77","source_type":"ngo","source_confidence":"medium_high","source_confidence_reason":"Direct Amnesty field reporting contemporaneous with the occupation; strong on the mechanism and victim groups, though based on interviews and UN verification rather than Russian admission.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly in-period, September 2022.","ruler_attribution":"High: the abusive screening and transfer regime operated in Russian-occupied territory under Russian military control.","contrary_evidence":["Russia portrayed movements as evacuations or temporary placement rather than forced transfer"],"lenses":["2B.4","2B.5","2B.10"]}

SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Доповідь ООН описує свавільні страти та напади на окремих цивільних осіб із боку російських військ на півночі України з лютого до квітня","publisher":"Моніторингова місія ООН з прав людини в Україні","publication_date":"2022-12-07","url":"https://ukraine.ohchr.org/uk/UN-report-details-summary-executions-of-civilians-by-Russian-troops-in-northern-Ukraine-from-February-to-April","claim":"The UN human-rights mission said Russian armed forces arbitrarily executed or attacked civilians in the early weeks of the invasion, causing hundreds of civilian deaths in Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Sumy oblasts between 24 February and 6 April 2022.","locator":"lines 79-86","source_type":"IGO","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Official UN monitoring report with concrete casualty totals and time/place bounds; strong independent corroboration of unlawful conduct.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly in-period, February-April 2022, reported in December 2022.","ruler_attribution":"High: the conduct is attributed to Russian troops acting under Putin's wartime command authority.","contrary_evidence":["Russia disputed blame for civilian deaths and denied unlawful targeting"],"lenses":["2B.4","2B.9","2B.10"]}

SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Recent challenges to security in Europe: what role for the Council of Europe?","publisher":"Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe","publication_date":"2022-06-21","url":"https://pace.coe.int/en/files/30160/html","claim":"PACE declared that the Russian Federation's unprovoked and unjustified war of aggression against Ukraine, waged in open defiance of international law, had gravely harmed the international order and unsettled the European multilateral architecture.","locator":"line 147","source_type":"IGO","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Formal adopted resolution of the Council of Europe, a strong legal-political record of international condemnation.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly in-period, June 2022.","ruler_attribution":"Moderate to high: the resolution concerns Russia's war of aggression under Putin's command, though it is an institutional finding rather than a transcript of his private decision.","contrary_evidence":["Russia rejected the characterization as aggression and argued its actions were defensive"],"lenses":["2B.2","2B.10"]}
